def test_filtered_pagination_fills_pages_and_skips_nothing():
    items = [{"id": n, "status": "open" if n % 3 == 0 else "closed"} for n in range(30)]
    expected = [i["id"] for i in items if i["status"] == "open"]  # 10 matches

    first = search(items, status="open", offset=0, limit=5)
    assert [i["id"] for i in first] == expected[:5]

    collected = []
    offset = 0
    while True:
        page = search(items, status="open", offset=offset, limit=5)
        if not page:
            break
        assert len(page) <= 5
        collected.extend(i["id"] for i in page)
        offset += 5
    assert collected == expected
